name: Coarse-Fine Sampling
definition: Renders images in two sequential passes: a coarse pass with a fixed number of samples, followed by a fine pass with additional samples drawn from the coarse density distribution, optionally using disparity-based depth sampling for better depth resolution.
summary: Coarse-Fine Sampling is a two-pass NeRF technique that uses a coarse density estimate to importance-sample a fine pass, concentrating computation on high-density regions.
